about:
Sonix Inc is headquartered in Springfield, Virginia, and has been operating since 1986. The company was founded as a pioneer in scanning acoustic microscopy for semiconductor defect detection. Today it operates as part of Tektronix, backed by Ralliant, a $6 billion diversified industrial growth company.

Sonix designs and manufactures the ECHO line of scanning acoustic microscopes used for nondestructive inspection of bonded wafers, packaged semiconductors, and industrial materials. Its systems deliver high-resolution subsurface imaging at production speeds, with automated wafer handling and sorting for pass/fail decisions. The product portfolio covers wafer inspection, package inspection, and industrial inspection applications, supported by a global network of sales, service, application engineering, and training facilities.

The company serves semiconductor manufacturers, MEMS producers (pressure sensors, microphones, gyroscopes, accelerometers), and industrial sectors including consumer electronics, automotive, and medical devices. Its microscopes are deployed from development labs to high-volume production floors worldwide.

Sonix emphasizes its global support infrastructure and long-standing innovation leadership as key differentiators. The company states that its commitment to service, combined with continuous ultrasonic technology advances, enables customers to improve yields and accelerate time-to-market for advanced electronics.
